title: `UnsatisfiedLinkError` with `--experimental_remote_cache_compression` on Windows

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

labels.name: team-OSS
labels.description: Issues for the Bazel OSS team: installation, release processBazel packaging, website

### What's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.


We reliably hit this on CI for https://github.com/CodeIntelligenceTesting/jazzer/pull/431.
The bazel command we run is:

```
bazelisk build --config=ci --remote_header=x-buildbuddy-api-key=REDACTED --java_runtime_version=local_jdk_8 --disk_cache=%HOME%/bazel-disk  //...
```

I don't expect this to be BuildBuddy-specific, but haven't been able to test it with other backends.

### Which operating system are you running Bazel on?


Windows

### What is the output of `bazel info release`?


5.3.0rc1
